items.title: New optogenetic tool inhibits activity in neurons and heart muscle cells
paras: Researchers from Ruhr University Bochum have partnered with colleagues in Göttingen, Berlin, Paris and Essen to develop new optogenetic tools that can selectively inhibit cellular activity through light. These tools could help investigate diseases in which the balance between excitation and inhibition is disrupted, such as cardiac arrhythmias.

items.title: On this day in space! Oct. 21, 2008: India launches its 1st mission to the moon with Chandrayaan-1
paras: India swung for the moon with Chandrayaan-1, its first deep space mission. 21, 2008, the Indian Space Research Organization launched its first mission to the moon. The mission was named Chandrayaan-1, and it consisted of both an orbiter and an impactor.

Chandrayaan-1 launched from the Satish Dhawan Space Center on an Indian rocket called the Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle, or PSLV-XL. items.title: Anderson, 44, not offered new Lancashire contract
paras: Cricket Correspondent Published 21 October 2026 James Anderson's legendary career could be over after Lancashire opted against offering England's all-time leading wicket-taker a new contract. Anderson, 44, chose to continue playing with Lancashire after England forced him into international retirement in 2024.

He captained Lancashire in the County Championship last season but the Red Rose endured a poor campaign, finishing next to bottom of Division Two. Now, as first reported by the Times, Anderson will not be given the opportunity to play at Old Trafford in 2027 - the summer when he will turn 45.
